title: FILMY AF @ ERA SAN JOSE
description: After a sold-out SF debut, FILMY AF hits San Jose! Bollywood classics, iconic hits & nonstop singalongs with DJ Rushil.
long_description:
After a sold-out SF debut, FILMY AF hits San Jose! Bollywood classics, iconic hits & nonstop singalongs with DJ Rushil.

About this Event

After a sold-out San Francisco debut last month, FILMY AF is heading to San Jose for the first time. The first one made one thing clear: people are ready for a Bollywood party that goes deeper than the same overplayed playlists every weekend.

🎟️ Welcome to FILMY AF 🎟️

A love letter to Bollywood music, FILMY AF brings together the best of Bollywood music there is: cult classics, forgotten favorites, massive singalongs, guilty pleasures, and the anthems you can’t help but love.

🎶 The Vibe
From ’90s nostalgia and peak 2000s Y2K to 2010s anthems and today’s chartbusters, expect a full journey through Bollywood music. Come ready for hook steps, chaotic room-wide singalongs, and those “wait, NO WAY” transitions.

🎧 On the Decks
DJ Rushil, one half of Lychy Jelly, takes over with a dedicated Bollywood originals set packed with the songs you know by heart and the ones you forgot you loved.

Come early. The journey starts at 10 PM sharp, and you won’t want to miss the opening stretch.

🎟️ The Details
Date: Friday, November 20
Time: 10 PM till late
Venue: Era Lounge, 386 S. 1st Street, San Jose

Text the group chat, grab your tickets, and come ready to lose your voice. San Jose, let’s show them how it’s done. 🔥
